limitations: P4 proves a correct, restartable on-policy PPO-2 loop. It does not prove learned playing strength or convergence.
The 20-iteration smoke is a correctness trial, not a throughput or cost-efficiency result.
CUDA kernels are not bitwise-reproducible; all CUDA comparisons use the predeclared FP32 bound.
The resume parity comparison reuses pre-recorded cohorts, permitted by the design for this narrow check only.
Actor-only P3 throughput (matches/s) is historical context and is NOT comparable to the P4 full-stack rate, which includes learner and checkpoint cost.
